intro.title: GST Overview Dashboard
intro.subtitle: Output tax liability, Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation, and net payable calculations

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 9, Part 1: GST Overview Dashboard: Output Tax versus Input Tax Credit. MediFlow provides automated Goods and Services Tax tracking directly synced with your counter sales and distributor purchases.
Navigate to GST Overview. The dashboard aggregates total outward tax collected from retail sales alongside inward ITC accrued from verified supplier GRNs.
Monitor your statutory tax position split clearly into Central GST, State GST, and Integrated GST components across any filing month.
Review net payable tax estimates after automatic ITC set-off, preventing cash surprises before filing deadlines.
Use the filing period selector to audit quarterly or monthly return cycles. In Part 2, we generate GSTR-1 outward supply files and HSN summaries!

outro.takeaway: GST Overview: Instantly compare Output Tax against Input Tax Credit to forecast statutory net tax payable with zero calculation errors.
